current_summary: Large title, optional basket bar, SearchField 'Search for a food', grouped result rows (category tile, name, 'Fridge · ~7 days', trailing + one-tap add with a Change toast; row body opens the confirm sheet), 'Add “x” as new item', Scan barcode / Snap groceries or receipt rows, RECENT (5 with +), confirm sheet (Cancel, item card, Leftovers chip for free text, Location segmented <=4 else picker, Expires with once-only explainer, Add to <Location>). Cost: catalog food = keyboard + 1 tap (+) or 2 (row -> Add); Recent re-buy = 1 tap but below the camera rows; free text = keyboard + 2.

apps.name: AnyList
apps.what: One Add Item field; suggestions from the built-in database, favorites and recents with a source icon each; tap adds, pencil edits first; Favorites and Recent are browsable lists.

aspects.aspect: Tap adds, pencil edits before adding
aspects.why: Makes the add the default and the decision opt-in, one affordance per row
Ambry's Recent is recency-only; staples want a frequency view

apps.name: Bring!
apps.what: Bottom field; tile catalog by category browsed without typing; green Recently used tiles; long-press a tile for quantity/notes.

aspects.why: A keyboard-free path to any staple

aspects.aspect: Recently used as a compact tile strip
aspects.why: Re-buys above the fold without a second list

apps.name: MyFitnessPal (food search)
apps.what: Before typing, Recent / Frequent / My foods lists sit under the search bar; the barcode button sits beneath the field.

aspects.why: Weekly staples are frequency, not recency

apps.name: Apple Reminders (Groceries list)
apps.what: Items auto-file into store sections as added; drag to another section and the list remembers the preference for that item.

aspects.why: The shelf heuristic should learn a corrected default per food

apps.name: Instacart
apps.what: 'Buy it again' badge on search results and a carousel on home; + on the tile adds.

aspects.why: Search and Recent become one list instead of two

directions.name: 1A Recents up front
directions.pitch: The tab's frequency claim is undone by putting Recent under the camera rows; put the re-buy where the thumb lands.
regions: Large title
Basket bar (only when staged)
SearchField
Frequent strip: 6-8 tile+name chips, tap adds with toast/Change, long-press opens the sheet
Results replace everything below the field while typing
Scan barcode / Snap groceries or receipt rows
Empty: no strip until 3 adds; camera rows stay
Error: existing toast
directions.cost: Re-buy 1 tap with no scroll; all else unchanged.
directions.tradeoff: A horizontal strip is a second list idiom on a screen that just lost one (S3); long-press is undiscoverable so the toast's Change must also reach the sheet.

directions.name: 1B Browse, don't type
directions.pitch: 421 curated rows are already cached on the client; a category grid reaches any staple with no keyboard.
regions: Large title
Basket bar
SearchField
Recent (5 rows)
Grid of the 12 CategoryTiles with counts
Scan / Snap rows
Tile pushes a category list: grouped catalog rows with subtitle and + (row -> sheet); search stays on top
Empty: never; a category with no visible rows is hidden
directions.cost: Staple = 2 taps, zero keyboard; search unchanged.
directions.tradeoff: Scrolling 40 rows beats two typed letters only for a new household: a discoverability win, not a speed win; the camera rows sink unless the grid is one row.

directions.name: 1C Tap adds, pencil edits
directions.pitch: A result row still has two affordances doing different things; make the row the add and demote the decision.
regions: As today, but the row commits with suggested defaults and a toast with Change
Trailing glyph becomes a pencil that opens the sheet first
Free-text row keeps the sheet
Confirm sheet unchanged
directions.cost: Any catalog food = keyboard + 1 tap; edit-first = 2.
directions.tradeoff: Change cannot move a row (merge_add_items returns no ids, spec 32 Follow-ups) so a wrong shelf becomes a second copy; honest only after a migration makes the RPC return what it wrote; strains ADR D3's 'type-ahead -> confirm card' beyond A7.

current_summary: ScreenHeader 'Scan barcode', camera card (reticle, hint, torch), 'Enter number instead' revealing a digits field + Look up, scan bar ('N staged' · Review). Detect -> haptic -> Worker lookup (catalog -> OFF -> not found) -> success haptic + live count; toast only for unknown, duplicate or error (Add by name action). Basket survives leaving; denied card keeps the digits field and Review. Cost: 0 taps per product; a session ends in 2 (Review -> Add N); an unknown barcode is named later in the editor (open + type + dismiss).

apps.name: Yuka
apps.what: Camera stays live; on recognition the colour verdict appears immediately as a card, tap for the full sheet.

aspects.aspect: Result as a card over the viewfinder
aspects.why: Feedback with content instead of a toast

apps.name: MyFitnessPal Multi-Add
apps.what: After the first scan, Multi-Add keeps the session open; each scan lands in a temporary list; log all at once; not-found prompts you to create the food.

aspects.why: The haul is reviewable without leaving the scanner

apps.name: Pantry Check

aspects.aspect: Queue under the viewfinder, commit from the scanner
aspects.why: Removes the second screen for a clean haul

apps.name: Sortly Quick Actions
apps.what: Choose the action first (adjust, move to folder, tag); every scan applies it; swipe between saved actions at the bottom.

aspects.aspect: Set the destination first, then scan
aspects.why: One tap per shelf instead of one edit per item

apps.name: Barcode Buddy (Grocy)
apps.what: Purchase/Consume modes switched by barcodes; unknown codes are looked up and parked under New Barcodes to associate later.

aspects.aspect: Unknowns parked without stopping the haul
aspects.why: Ambry already does this; keep it

apps.name: Apple Camera
apps.what: Passive QR detection with a tappable badge; no shutter.

aspects.aspect: The scanner never asks for a tap
aspects.why: Zero-tap capture is the bar

directions.name: 2A Queue under the viewfinder
directions.pitch: The review screen is a second screen for a list the scanner already holds; show the staged rows here and commit here.
regions: ScreenHeader
Camera ~45% height: reticle, torch, 'Enter number instead' as an overlay button
Staged cells newest first (GroupedRow: name or warn 'Name this product', location Chip, '~7d', tick); tapping an unknown row opens TextPrompt
Footer: Add N to pantry (primary) · Review (secondary); primary disabled with the review's hint while a row needs attention
Empty: full-height camera, today's copy
Denied card unchanged
Error: toast with Add by name

borrowed.aspect: Queue under the scanner + Add to Inventory

directions.cost: Clean haul = 1 tap (was 2); unknown named in 1 tap + typing, no modal.
directions.tradeoff: Two commit surfaces must share BasketReview's commit (extract it); the camera loses height on small phones; ADR D3 holds because the queue is the review.

directions.name: 2B Set the shelf first
directions.pitch: Review-time location edits exist because the heuristic guesses per item; when one bag goes to one shelf, say so once.
regions: ScreenHeader
Camera with an overlay SegmentedControl: Auto · Fridge · Pantry · Freezer (>4 locations -> a Chip opening LocationPickerModal); the mode stamps every following scan
Scan bar reads '6 staged · to Freezer' while a mode is set
Enter number instead / denied card / errors unchanged
directions.cost: 1 tap per shelf change, 0 per item; single-shelf hauls need no review edits.
directions.tradeoff: A forgotten mode misfiles a batch: Auto is the default, the count names the mode, and review chips remain.

directions.name: 2C Result card, camera stays live
directions.pitch: Replace haptic-plus-count with a card carrying the fact worth checking.
regions: ScreenHeader
Full-height camera
Per scan a card slides up over the bottom third for ~2.5 s: photo tile · name · 'Fridge · ~7 days' · Change chip · ×
Unknown: 'Unknown barcode' card with an inline Name it field
Duplicate: card says so; error: card with Add by name
Scan bar (count · Review) under the camera
directions.cost: 0 taps per known product; shelf change 2 taps now instead of in review; unknown named now.
directions.tradeoff: A card over the reticle fights framing on small screens; more motion on a one-handed screen; VoiceOver keeps today's announcement.

screen: Receipt / photo capture (camera-first, AI parse, quota meter)
current_summary: ScreenHeader 'Snap groceries or receipt'; viewfinder with overlay Receipt | Groceries control, corner glyphs Photos / PDF, shutter; one meter line naming the binding allowance; preview (image, hint, privacy line, Scan receipt, Retake/Cancel); analyzing (skeleton rows, Hide, continues in background); parse stages into the basket and opens the review; zero-items, quota upsell, daily cap, permission and retryable errors each keep Retake / Choose another / Try this photo again with an honest cost note. Cost: Snap row (1) -> shutter (2) -> Scan (3) -> review -> Add N (4); the 5-15 s wait holds the screen.

apps.name: Expensify SmartScan
apps.what: Camera first; gallery bottom-left, shutter bottom-right; Rapid Fire shoots a stack of receipts in a row; details fill in afterwards and you carry on.

aspects.why: The wait need not hold the screen
Several receipts in one visit

apps.name: Dext
apps.what: Single / Multiple / Combine modes at the bottom of the camera; Combine stitches a long receipt across up to 50 shots into one item; a Processing section tops the inbox while extraction runs.

aspects.why: A supermarket receipt does not fit one frame

aspects.aspect: Processing as a section of the list
aspects.why: Progress lives where the result lands

apps.name: Apple Notes scanner

aspects.aspect: Count on the commit button; two verbs on a preview
aspects.why: Says what will be sent; edge detection itself is outside expo-camera

apps.name: Fetch
apps.what: Frame squarely, shoot, then slide the camera icon into the circle to submit; green checks for store/date/total; X to retake; long receipts need several photos.

aspects.why: Keeps the quota gate without a third screen
Long receipts are the common receipt

apps.name: Wave
apps.what: Long receipts captured in multiple sections; bulk-upload up to 10; mark as reviewed later.

aspects.why: Confirms the pattern across a second product

directions.name: 3A Long receipt as parts
directions.pitch: A supermarket receipt does not fit one frame; the spec calls multi-shot 'a v2'.
regions: Viewfinder as today
After the shutter the frame shrinks to a thumbnail strip ('Part 1'); camera stays live with an 'Add next part' hint
'Scan 2 parts' replaces the right corner glyph once a part exists
Preview: swipeable parts with Retake each
Analyzing / quota / cap / error states and the meter unchanged
directions.cost: +1 tap per extra part; still one Scan tap and one charge.
directions.tradeoff: The route takes one image; the honest build accepts up to 3 in one call (server change, escalation); client-side stitching under the <=1600 px downscale loses legibility.

directions.name: 3B The shutter is the gate
directions.pitch: For a camera shot the preview repeats the viewfinder; keep the deliberate gesture as the shutter plus a short undo.
regions: Viewfinder, mode control, meter and corner glyphs as today
Shutter -> frame freezes for 2.5 s as a chip 'Sending… Undo'; nothing leaves the phone before the window closes
Camera returns live; further shots queue as chips: Reading… / 7 items / Couldn't read · Retry
Privacy line becomes a caption under the meter
Library and PDF picks keep the preview
Quota / cap / permission states unchanged
directions.cost: Snap (1) -> shutter (2) -> review -> Add (3); a second receipt is one more tap.
directions.tradeoff: ADR D3 says 'after a preview'; the undo window is a preview in time, not in space: escalate in the PR. A pocket shutter is bounded by the window and the focus-unmount.

directions.name: 3C Reading happens in the basket
directions.pitch: The analyzing screen is dead time; the parse already outlives the screen, so let the wait live where the result lands.
regions: Viewfinder
Preview with Scan receipt as today
On Scan: back to the live viewfinder with a 'Reading… lands in your basket' toast
Add tab basket bar and badge read 'Reading receipt… · 2 staged'
Review shows a Reading… section of skeleton cells above the rows that fills in place
Zero items: toast with Retake; retryable error: toast with Try again reopening the preview
Quota / cap keep their full states

borrowed.aspect: Details fill in after the shot

directions.cost: Same four taps; no held screen; a second receipt starts at once.
directions.tradeoff: Toast errors can be missed (mitigation: the Reading section becomes an error cell with the same buttons); BasketContext gains a pending-parse count.

screen: Capture review list (grouped cells, per-row location/expiry, bulk tick, add all)

directions.name: 4A Swipe-through ticks and a selection bar
directions.pitch: 'Put everything in…' acts on all rows while the ticks say which rows matter; make the ticks the selection.
regions: ScreenHeader
Header: 'N of M' only (Clear moves to an OverflowMenu)
Cells as today; a drag down the checkbox column ticks or unticks a run
When the ticked set differs from all, a selection bar above the CTA: Put N in… · Remove N
Attention line and CTA as today
Empty / error unchanged
directions.cost: Untick 6 = one drag; move 8 rows = drag + 2 taps (was 16).
directions.tradeoff: A pan gesture over a FlatList needs gesture-handler care and a VoiceOver route (the bulk tick stays); include and select must be one meaning.

directions.name: 4B Grouped by shelf
directions.pitch: The reviewer's real question is whether each item is going to the right shelf; answer it by reading, not by opening chips.
regions: ScreenHeader
Summary line
Sections per location ('Fridge · 6', 'Pantry · 4') with a per-section 'all to…'
Rows keep receipt order within a section; the location chip goes
A row moves by drag to another section (the zones drag from #180) or via the editor
A we-weren't-sure row adds a 'Try: …' alternative chip when candidates has one
Attention line and CTA as today
One location: no section headers; empty unchanged
directions.cost: Verifying shelves = 0 taps; a move = 1 drag; a whole section = 2 taps.
directions.tradeoff: Drag inside a sectioned FlatList is the heaviest build here; receipt order is split across shelves so checking against paper is harder; the editor's raw-text meta remains.

directions.name: 4C Fix in place
directions.pitch: Every attention reason is a name problem; a pageSheet is the wrong tool for a one-word fix.
regions: Header as today
Tapping a needs-a-name row opens TextPrompt inline, validated by rowNameInvalid
A we-weren't-sure caption becomes chips: Keep · Find in catalog (type-ahead as a sheet; relinking restores the estimate)
Last cell: 'Add something the scan missed' -> search or scan
Chevron / editor stays for notes and category
Attention line and CTA unchanged

borrowed.aspect: Tap an item to correct; Add Item by barcode or search
Add extras via search from the review

directions.cost: Naming = 1 tap + typing, no modal; a missed line = 1 tap + search; a relink = 2 taps.
directions.tradeoff: A keyboard inside a FlatList needs scroll-to-focused handling; 'Find in catalog' must reuse SearchCapture's rows rather than add a fourth list.
